+from datetime import date
+
+from bank import ledger
+from bank.money import Money
+
+
+def _two_accounts(conn):
+    a = ledger.open_account(conn, ledger.create_customer(conn, "Ref Payer"), "EUR")
+    b = ledger.open_account(conn, ledger.create_customer(conn, "Ref Payee"), "EUR")
+    ledger.deposit(conn, a.id, Money.of("50.00", "EUR"))
+    return a, b
+
+
+def _references(conn, account):
+    st = ledger.statement(conn, account.id, date(2000, 1, 1), date(2999, 1, 1))
+    return [line.reference for line in st.lines if line.kind == "transfer"]
+
+
+def test_BENCH23_blank_reference_is_stored_as_none(conn):
+    a, b = _two_accounts(conn)
+    ledger.transfer(conn, a.id, b.id, Money.of("5.00", "EUR"), reference="   ")
+    assert _references(conn, a) == [None]
+
+
+def test_BENCH23_reference_is_stored_without_surrounding_spaces(conn):
+    a, b = _two_accounts(conn)
+    ledger.transfer(conn, a.id, b.id, Money.of("5.00", "EUR"), reference="  rent May ")
+    assert _references(conn, b) == ["rent May"]
